title: Lead Scraping With Ahrefs — Operation: Competitor Spying
summary: Your online visibility can be boosted at significantly lower costs with SEO. And SEO depends heavily on backlinks. This episode covers Operation Competitor Spying — using Ahrefs to find which sites have granted your competitors backlinks, and how to filter those leads to only target sites that will actually boost your search engine rankings.
show_notes_text:
### Operation: Competitor Spying — Lead Scraping With Ahrefs

SEO depends heavily on backlinks — but how do you find the right sites to target for outreach?

This episode covers Operation Competitor Spying: checking your competitors via Ahrefs (or similar software) to see which sites have granted them backlinks.

**The catch:** You've got to filter the leads you find smartly to only end up with sites that will actually boost your rankings.

**Related resources:**
- Collab Link Building (S02E06): https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/podcast/collab-link-building-s02e06/
- Case study — NTA to $1.2M/month from organic: https://dmr.agency/case-studies/national-tyres-and-auto-care-case-study/
- Tool: ahrefs.com
